mxCell.value: HDIP 0.1 — M15-V04: Registry, Resolution, Projection & Compilation View
Enterprise semantic meaning → Governed references → Contextual resolution → Operational projections and realization
One holistic enterprise architecture across Data, Information and Intelligence · Visual projection of frozen M09 / M15 / M17
1. Enterprise Semantic Corpus & Authoritative Context — Outside HDIP Ownership
Governed meaning, business relationships and context are essential inputs to P1/P2 resolution; HDIP references their authority.
2. Governed Logical Registries — Register References, Not the Meaning They Point To
Five canonical core Registry responsibilities (REG-01..05) · data-specific ADS registration is a separate Profile specialization.
Scoped Authorized Data Source designations, references, currentness and evidence; not a universal cross-family registry.
Registry Entry Contract: stable identity · version · currentness · effective period · authoritative references · evidence / provenance
3. P1/P2 — Semantic Grounding, Discovery, Resolution, Validation & Compilation
Illustrative logical responsibilities across P1/P2; not five additional Planes or a mandatory physical execution pipeline.
Operational projections, compiled realization artifacts and compilation evidence
Family-authoritative artifacts; referenced or generated only where applicable
6. Product-Family Applicability — Illustrative Examples, Not Uniform Mandatory Artifact Lists
HDIP Context — One Holistic Logical Architecture, Not a Mandatory Deployment Topology
Enables compute, storage, messaging, identity, orchestration and runtime realization; does not confer semantic, Product or enterprise authority.
• Enterprise Semantic Corpus supplies governed meaning and relationships.
• Logical Registries govern registration facts and references, not subject semantics.
• HDIP resolves, validates and compiles context without inventing authority.
• HPD is the canonical HDIP Product operational projection.
• Product-family artifacts retain applicable independent authority.
• AI Product ≠ Model Product; intelligence need not be ML-only.
• Data / Information / Intelligence retain distinct semantics
• All Data, Information and Intelligence responsibilities can be served by one HDIP architecture.
• One physical implementation may implement several distinct logical Registry responsibilities.
• ADS Registry applies only to the Data Profile.
• PROD, PDS and DPP appear by applicable family/framework; none is universally generated by HDIP.
• Intelligence may be model-based, symbolic, knowledge-based, agentic or hybrid.
No source authority capture · No automatic conformance · No universal artifact list or physical pipeline
Enterprise meaning grounds intent; HDIP resolves, projects and compiles governed context into realizable capabilities.
Independent semantic, Product, source, policy and consequential Decision/Action authorities remain preserved.
